summary: This directory provides a comprehensive toolkit for processing CSV data. It facilitates the bidirectional transformation between structured records and CSV-formatted streams, including support for schema-based reading, raw data parsing, and flexible encoding options for structured data output.
responsibilities: Parse CSV input streams into structured records
Encode structured data streams into CSV format
Define schema and configuration types for CSV operations
Handle raw and schema-validated CSV data transformations
relationships: CSV parsing functions transform raw streams into structured records based on defined schemas.
CSV encoding functions convert structured records into formatted CSV streams using provided write options.
Type definitions for columns and records ensure consistency between the structured domain models and the serialized CSV output.
designDecisions: Configuration-based options for reading and writing
Separation between raw and schema-aware processing functions
Type-safe interfaces for CSV cell and row definitions
